text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp's coming to an end…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And Seiun Sky did everything I asked of her at camp, but…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: No, get over that already. This is a secret tactical meeting! You do wanna come up with a strategy for the Kikuka Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unlike last year, she didn't offer up a single strategy. So now…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! I've gone from first-rate to outlandishly superior first-rate!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: No, it's quite all right. Sky's fecklessness is her issue.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I've polished my racing arsenal, you know—sufficiently enough to crush you in the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: But what's happened with you? Did you spend your summer continuing down the path of impropriety?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …I dunno. Trainer, I'm gonna go ahead and get on the bus.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: She hasn't seriously lost her will to fight, has she?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ever since the Takarazuka Kinen, she's been acting so strangely. Did she lose her desire to race after competing against Special Week and the others?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky has overcome obstacle after obstacle without giving up once. There's no way she'd throw in the towel now.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Remember—you mustn't be afraid to use the stick when the carrot doesn't do the job.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp is over, but I'm left with some work to do as a trainer.
